note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, Main menu, Search, Donate, Create account, Log in
Page title bar -- renders: 'Search' (fixed special page title), Help link
Appearance settings panel -- renders: Appearance, Unpin, Font size, Standard, Larger, Smaller, Limited width, Yes, No, Theme, System, Day, Night
Search form controls -- renders: Search label, Search button; excludes the query input and the dynamic result count
Advanced search options toggle -- renders: 'Search options' (fixed label)
Namespace filter toggle -- renders: 'Namespaces' (fixed label) and standard namespace names (Main, Talk, etc.)
Create page prompt -- renders: 'Create the page' and standard help links (fixed platform copy)
Results per page selector -- renders: 10, 20, 50, 100, 200 (fixed pagination options)

Site footer -- renders: Privacy policy, About Wikipedia, Disclaimers, Contact Wikipedia, Legal & safety contacts, Code of conduct, Developers, Statistics, Cookie statement, Mobile view, Wikimedia Foundation, Powered by MediaWiki
